summary: Verified /track-order fix on Next.js frontend. The 308 redirect loop is gone (curl -I returns HTTP 200), the new client page renders with all required data-testids (track-order-page, track-order-form, track-order-number-input, track-order-email-input, track-order-submit). Submitting an invalid order+email surfaces an inline error (track-order-error with text 'Order not found'). Header nav 'Track Order' link (data-testid='nav-track-order') now points to internal /track-order with no target=_blank. Footer 'Track Order' link also points to /track-order. Regression paths /, /products, /wholesale all return 200. All five requested features pass.
critical_code_review_comments: page.js correctly uses relative /api/orders/track so Next rewrites proxy to backend — good.
Minor: track-order page uses process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL but falls back to '' (relative) which is correct; no action needed.
Unrelated console errors on homepage (401/404 from analytics/wishlist probes) pre-existed and are not related to this fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Track-order feature on Next.js frontend-next is fully functional. next.config.js redirect loop removed; only /collection and /why-choose-addrika redirects remain. Backend GET /api/orders/track returns 404 for unknown orders and page displays detail text 'Order not found' inline.
rca of the issue: Original 308 loop was caused by a self-referencing permanent redirect /track-order -> https://www.centraders.com/track-order in next.config.js on the same host. Removing that entry + adding a real internal page resolved the loop.
